title: Kissed Rich Italian Tomato Bruschetta
description: A rich Italian dish featuring tomato puree and tempering chocolate, this Whole30-friendly bruschetta is perfect for a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine diced tomatoes, chopped basil, and minced garlic.
Drizzle olive oil and balsamic vinegar over the tomato mixture and toss to coat.
Arrange gluten-free bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the bread from the oven and top each slice with a spoonful of the tomato mixture.
Place a slice of mozzarella cheese on top of the tomato mixture.
Melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler and drizzle over the mozzarella cheese.
Return the bruschetta to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
